verdict.rationale: Scribe documents a natural-language instruction applied to the final transcript, returning AI-processed text in 'edited_transcript' (docs-8). This is a first-party way to get LLM output from your own data, but it is framed as editing rather than insights or suggestions. Entity timestamps and sound-event tagging (docs-7, docs-9) enrich transcripts but are not insights. Missing for 10: documented insight/summary/suggestion features, any in-app (Studio) insights surface, and evidence that the instruction feature produces analytical output rather than edits.
